findings.label: version without migrate
findings.detail: receiptStore persist declares version: 1 but no migrate function; migration/reconciliation is handled entirely in the custom merge via mergeLayout. This is correct and robust (self-heals partial/stale layouts on every rehydrate), but a future version bump that adds a migrate could run alongside merge and confuse a maintainer. Optional: drop version or add a comment that merge owns reconciliation. Not required to ship.
